scope: hostname equals configured public API hostname
origin_access: For Worker topology, require a Cloudflare Access service token at the origin hostname to prevent gateway bypass.
tls: Full (strict); minimum TLS 1.2; SSL termination at Cloudflare for public hostnames
private_network: Private .internal routes require WARP, device access policy, private DNS and a separately trusted HTTPS ingress. Public-zone WAF rules do not secure arbitrary private routes.
rate_limits: Worker bindings are per Cloudflare location and eventually consistent; database/API admission limits remain authoritative.
